findings.unit: pla_e00_destroyer (Type 052C Luyang II 2004 / Type 052D Luyang III 2014)
findings.whatTheGameHas: One weapon, w_e00_pla_destroyer, named "052C: 6 x 8 revolver VLS" with tgt {ground:1,air:0,sea:1,sub:0}, proj "shell", sfx "cannon", speed 720, aoe 0.9, r 11.0. The unit has no second weapon. Measured: the class cannot engage an aircraft at all, and its unit sight is 11.0.
findings.whatIsReal: Lanzhou (DDG-170) commissioned July 2004 with a Type 346 active phased array and six eight-round revolver launchers, 48 rounds of HHQ-9 — the PLAN's first area air-defence ship and the entire reason the class is nicknamed China's Aegis. The Type 052D of 2014 replaced the revolvers with 64 universal cells firing the same round. The weapon in the game is NAMED after that launcher and is modelled as a gun that cannot shoot up.
findings.fix: Split into two weapons: keep the gun (100mm Type 210 on the 052C, H/PJ-38 130mm on the 052D) and add w_e00_pla_destroyer_sam, an HHQ-9 area SAM at tgt {air:1} only, range 13.6, speed 610, profile pop, intercept 0.62. Edit 1 and 2.

findings.unit: missileboat_c (Type 022 Houbei) and corvette_c (Type 056 Jiangdao), e20
findings.whatTheGameHas: NAVY.missileboat_c weapons ["ssm_yj18"] and NAVY.corvette_c weapons ["navgun_76","ssm_yj18","ciws_pj11"]. Resolved: ssm_yj18__missileboat_c and ssm_yj18__corvette_c, "YJ-18 SSM", r 16.9, dmg 300. Four independent places in the same repo say YJ-83 instead: the unit name "Type 022 (YJ-83)", the desc "Eight YJ-83 anti-ship missiles on a stealth catamaran", facts.js missileboat_c "8x YJ-83 anti-ship missiles", and warship_specs.js missileboat_c designation "Type 022 Houbei (YJ-83)" with vls:0, launchers:"box" (and corvette_c "two twin YJ-83 boxes amidships").
findings.whatIsReal: YJ-18 is a VLS round. It goes to sea in the 850 mm universal cells of the Type 052D (2014) and the Type 055 (2020) and in the tubes of the Type 093B. A 220-tonne wave-piercing catamaran with four flush box launchers and an 89 m, ~1,500-tonne Type 056 with two twin box launchers have no vertical cell between them and physically cannot fire it. Both carry YJ-83 (C-802A). This is exactly the defect the brief describes on the Los Angeles boats: the prose promised one thing and the weapon list delivered another.
findings.fix: Add a shared ssm_yj83 weapon (dmg 235, range 14.5, speed 118, profile skim, intercept 0.95, tgt sea only) and put it on missileboat_c and corvette_c. Edits 6 and 8. Also re-key FIXED_MAGAZINE.missileboat_c to ssm_yj83 (edit 13).

findings.unit: missileboat_c (Type 022) — root cause is cross-faction, in js/entities.js
findings.whatTheGameHas: FIXED_MAGAZINE declares missileboat_c: { ssm_yj18: 8 } and entities.js reads this.def.magazine[this.def.weapons[wi]]. Measured after generations.js: the resolved id is "ssm_yj18__missileboat_c", so the lookup returns undefined and the magazine is never decremented. Measured across all 11 hulls that declare a magazine, the lookup misses on 10 of them — cruiser_p, destroyer_p, corvette_p, missileboat_p, corvette_k, missileboat_k, corvette_r, missileboat_r, missileboat_c, ssgn_p. Only missileboat_n still works, and only because every NATO DOMAIN multiplier is 1.00 so its Harpoon was never cloned.
findings.whatIsReal: The mechanic the code's own comments celebrate — "a Slava's first salvo is terrifying and her second does not exist", "what is in the tubes when the ship sails is what she has" — is switched off for every non-NATO ship in the game. A Type 022 fires unlimited heavy anti-ship missiles. So does a Slava, a Sovremenny, an Osa and an Oscar II.
findings.fix: Fall back to the base weapon id ahead of the "__" clone suffix, in both the fire() lookup and reloadAtYard(). Edits 15 and 16. One change fixes all ten hulls; it is inside my faction's blast radius because missileboat_c is one of them, but the owner should know it is a fleet-wide repair.

findings.unit: destroyer_c (Type 052D) and cruiser_c (Type 055), e20
findings.whatTheGameHas: No Chinese land-attack cruise missile exists anywhere in WEAPONS — grep CJ-10 across js/ finds it only in facts.js prose and two rules.js comments about off-map fire. The ships reach a target ashore solely through ssm_yj18's tgt.ground = 1. Measured: ssm_yj18 has exactly four users, all four PLA e20 hulls, so the bit also hands land attack to a missile boat and a coastal corvette.
findings.whatIsReal: YJ-18 is an anti-ship missile with an active radar seeker looking for a ship-sized return — the same trap the brief flags on Granit/SS-N-19. The round the PLAN sends at a target ashore is the CJ-10 out of the same universal cell. The repo's own facts.js already asserts it: cruiser_c armament "112-cell universal VLS (HHQ-9B, YJ-18, CJ-10, Yu-8)", destroyer_c "64-cell universal VLS (HHQ-9B, YJ-18, CJ-10, Yu-8)", and the destroyer's note reads "Its 64 universal cells launch air-defence, anti-ship, land-attack and anti-submarine missiles from the same silo." The card claimed a capability the weapon table did not have, under a designation that was wrong.
findings.fix: Add lacm_cj10 (dmg 255, range 18.0, speed 112, profile cruise, intercept 1.45, tgt ground ONLY), give it to destroyer_c and cruiser_c, and clear tgt.ground on ssm_yj18 so the Houbei and the Jiangdao lose a capability they never had. Edits 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12. Note that this is correctly era-bounded: the Luda, Luhu, Jiangwei and Jiangdao get nothing, because for most of this game's span China had no way to strike land from the sea at all.

findings.unit: Type 054A Jiangkai II — absent from every era
findings.whatTheGameHas: Nothing. grep "054" / "Jiangkai" / "HQ-16" / "HHQ-16" across js/ returns no naval hit. The only PLAN escort below destroyer size in e00 and e20 is the Type 056, a ~1,500-tonne coastal corvette which in e00 has one 76mm gun and nothing else.
findings.whatIsReal: The Type 054A is the ship the PLAN actually escorts with: first hull Xuzhou (530) commissioned January 2008, about thirty in commission, 32-cell VLS with HHQ-16 (~40 km) plus Yu-8 ASROC from the same cells, a Type 382 radar and a helicopter hangar. HHQ-16 is the PLAN's medium-range area air defence and the middle rung of exactly the distinction the brief asks about — the game currently knows only "HHQ-9 destroyer" and "corvette with no SAM at all", with nothing between them for 2008-2026.
findings.fix: No code proposed, because the honest fix is a roster decision the owner should make rather than a mechanical edit: there is one corvette slot per faction per era, and putting the 054A in it means the Type 056 leaves e00 or e20, which also moves warship_specs.js (hull length, beam, vls:32, launchers:"vls") and therefore the 3D model. Recommend: make the e20 corvette slot the Type 054A Jiangkai II with HHQ-16, and leave e00 as the Type 056. Flagged, not patched.

findings.unit: PLA missile boat, e80 and e90
findings.whatTheGameHas: No row at all — not a hull, not a NONE placeholder. Measured by listing every `^  pla_e80_*` and `^  pla_e90_*` id in eras.js: the naval rows are corvette, destroyer, sub (e80) and carrier, corvette, destroyer, sub (e90). For comparison pact has an e80 missileboat, and kpa and roc each have e80 and e90 missileboats.
findings.whatIsReal: This is a gap reality does not justify, which is the opposite of the realism-over-symmetry case. Through the 1980s and 1990s the PLAN operated the largest missile-boat force in the world: over a hundred Type 021 Huangfeng and Type 024 Houku carrying SY-1/HY-2, joined by the Type 037-1G Houxin (1991, YJ-8 series) and the Type 037-II Houjian (1991, six YJ-8). The game already models this doctrine in e60 and again in e00 and calls it out in the e60 desc — "that doctrine survives directly into the Type 022 of the 2000s" — and then omits the two decades in the middle.
findings.fix: Author pla_e80_missileboat (Type 037-1G Houxin / Type 021, service 1991, YJ-8 / C-801, ~4-6 rounds) and pla_e90_missileboat (Type 037-II Houjian, service 1991-95, six YJ-8). No code proposed: adding two era rows plus two era weapons plus two warship_specs entries is a larger authoring job than an audit patch, and the hull figures should be picked by whoever owns the era tables.

findings.unit: pla_e80_destroyer (Type 051 Luda, in service 1971)
findings.whatTheGameHas: w_e80_pla_destroyer is named "H/PJ-38 130mm".
findings.whatIsReal: H/PJ-38 is the single 130 mm mount that first went to sea on Kunming (DDG-172) in 2014 — forty-three years after the Luda. rules.js already carries it correctly as navgun_pj38 for the Type 052D and Type 055, so the same designation was on two ships four decades apart. The Luda's battery is the Type 76 twin 130 mm, a Soviet SM-2-1 derivative, two mounts fore and aft — which is precisely what the e60 row calls "4 x 130mm" for the identical hull, and what warship_specs.js pla_e80_destroyer records as guns:2, gunCal:130.
findings.fix: Rename to "2 x twin 130mm Type 76". Edit 3.

findings.unit: corvette_c (Type 056 Jiangdao) and carrier_c (Type 003 Fujian), e20
findings.whatTheGameHas: corvette_c has no air-defence missile of any kind — a 76mm gun, an SSM and a CIWS. carrier_c has exactly one weapon, ciws_pj11. Meanwhile pla_e00_carrier, the OLDER row, correctly carries "HQ-10 point defence", so the e20 carrier is a regression from the e00 one.
findings.whatIsReal: HHQ-10 (FL-3000N) is on the Type 056, the Type 052D, the Type 055, Liaoning, Shandong and Fujian. warship_specs.js already describes it on the Chinese corvettes — "an 8-cell HQ-10 box on the hangarless flight deck aft", "an HQ-10 launcher on the after deckhouse" — and facts.js carrier_c lists "HHQ-10 SAM launchers and Type 1130 CIWS for self-defence". The NAVY table's vls:8 on corvette_c is that HHQ-10 box, and nothing was firing out of it.
findings.fix: Add a shared sam_hhq10 point-defence weapon (dmg 105, range 4.4, speed 560, profile pop, intercept 0.75, tgt air only — deliberately about a third of HHQ-9's reach so the escort/air-defence-ship distinction stays visible) and give it to corvette_c and carrier_c. Sized against sam_ram, the RIM-116 that fills the same slot in NATO. Edits 7, 8, 11, 12.

findings.unit: pla_e80_destroyer (Type 051 Luda) and pla_e90_destroyer (Type 052 Luhu)
findings.whatTheGameHas: One gun each and nothing else. Luda: r 10.2. Luhu: "100mm twin gun", r 10.7.
findings.whatIsReal: The Luda was built around six HY-2 (SY-1A / CSS-N-2) in two triple launchers amidships — the missile is the reason the hull exists, and warship_specs.js pla_e80_destroyer already records launchers:"box". The Type 052 Luhu carried sixteen YJ-83/C-802 in four quad boxes between its two funnels, plus an eight-cell HQ-7; warship_specs.js pla_e90_destroyer says launchers:"box", ciws:4, helo:"hangar". So a Chinese destroyer in the game has no way to sink a ship beyond ten tiles in either decade, while a 1965 Osa boat in e60 reaches 13.9.
findings.fix: Append an SSM weapon to each era row. No code proposed here to keep this patch surgical, but note the constraint that makes it systemic: MEASURED, 170 of the 174 era naval hulls in eras.js carry exactly one weapon each (the four exceptions are gbr/fra/deu patrol boats). This is a structural property of the generated era tables and is not PLA-specific — see the risks list.

findings.unit: pla_e90_corvette (Type 053H2G Jiangwei-I 1992 / Type 053H3 Jiangwei-II)
findings.whatTheGameHas: One weapon, "100mm gun", g1 a1 s1 u0, r 7.7. Its desc reads: "The first Chinese frigates carrying an area SAM launcher rather than only guns. The Jiangwei-I's HQ-61 was poor; the Jiangwei-II swapped it for the HQ-7, which worked."
findings.whatIsReal: The Jiangwei-I did carry a six-cell HQ-61 and the Jiangwei-II an octuple HQ-7 (Crotale derivative), and warship_specs.js line 107 describes exactly that — "an octuple HQ-7 bin behind it". The desc names the class's single defining feature and the weapon list does not contain it. Same defect class as the Tomahawk-less Los Angeles. (The HQ-61/HQ-7 is point defence, not area defence, so the desc also overstates by one rung.)
findings.fix: Either append an HQ-7 point-defence SAM to the row, or soften the desc to say short-range rather than area. No code proposed — same one-weapon-per-era-hull constraint as the finding above.

findings.unit: w_e50_pla_missileboat (weapon of the purged 1950s NONE row)
findings.whatTheGameHas: Named "YJ-18 SSM", tgt g1 a0 s1 u0, range 12.6, profile loft. The unit pla_e50_missileboat is named "NONE" and is deleted by isPhantomUnit() before play, so nothing ever fires it (measured: it is absent from UNITS at runtime).
findings.whatIsReal: YJ-18 is a missile of roughly 2015. The row's own description says "China had no anti-ship missile and no missile boat in the 1950s ... The first Chinese missile boats - the Type 024 Houku - do not appear until 1966." The weapon table contradicts the roster it serves by sixty years, even though the contradiction is currently unreachable.
findings.fix: Rename to "none - Type 025/026 torpedo boats only". Edit 4.

findings.unit: w_e90_pla_carrier (weapon of the purged 1990s NONE row)
findings.whatTheGameHas: Named "H/PJ-11 CIWS", g0 a1 s0 u0, r 2.9. Unit pla_e90_carrier is "NONE" / "no aircraft carrier" and is purged.
findings.whatIsReal: The H/PJ-11 eleven-barrel gatling did not go to sea until Liaoning herself, 2012. The row records that the Varyag hull sat unfinished at Dalian through the 1990s.
findings.fix: Rename to "none - Varyag hull laid up at Dalian". Edit 5.

findings.unit: boat_c (role patrol, e20 file, stamped from:"e50")
findings.whatTheGameHas: Named "Type 022 Houbei", desc "Wave-piercing catamaran missile boat, here in its gun-armed patrol fit." Available from e50 because role "patrol" is in ERA_TIMELESS. It duplicates the hull name of missileboat_c and of pla_e00_missileboat — three Type 022s in one faction.
findings.whatIsReal: The Type 022 entered service in 2004 and there is no gun-armed patrol variant of it. The ERA_TIMELESS comment defends the ROLE spanning the game ("between a Project 183 and a Mk VI there is a diesel"), not the hull name, and this hull name puts a 2004 catamaran in Korea in 1950. The PLAN's genuinely timeless inshore gunboat is the Type 062 Shanghai — about four hundred built from 1962 and still in service into the 2010s. NOTE: this is systemic, not PLA-only — NATO's patrol boat is a "Mk VI" (2015), the Pact's a "Project 21630" (2006), Taiwan's a "Kuang Hua VI" (2010).
findings.fix: Rename boat_c to the Type 062 Shanghai and adjust the desc. No code proposed because the same rename is owed to four other factions and should be done as one pass.

findings.unit: cruiser_c (Type 055 Renhai)
findings.whatTheGameHas: shoreBombard:true on the unit and a desc that leans on it — "a superb shore bombardment platform". Measured: grep shoreBombard across the entire repository returns exactly three hits, all three of them the definitions themselves (rules.js:626, :631, :1039). Nothing reads the flag.
findings.whatIsReal: The claim is true of the ship and inert in the code. With CJ-10 added the desc becomes true in play as well, via the missile rather than the flag.
findings.fix: Either give shoreBombard a reader or drop it. No code proposed — it touches two non-PLA hulls as well.

findings.unit: corvette_c (Type 056 Jiangdao), e20
findings.whatTheGameHas: ciws_pj11, the H/PJ-11 eleven-barrel 30 mm gatling.
findings.whatIsReal: The Type 056/056A mounts two H/PJ-17 30 mm single remote mounts, not a gatling CIWS. The H/PJ-11 belongs to the Type 052D, the Type 055 and the carriers. A real but small difference.
findings.fix: Would need a new 30 mm remote-mount weapon. Left alone deliberately — recording a designation this small as a new WEAPONS key adds more noise than it removes, and the brief's rule is not to invent.

findings.unit: destroyer_c (Type 052D) and cruiser_c (Type 055), e20
findings.whatTheGameHas: sam_hhq9 "HHQ-9B", r 13.9, dmg 180, profile pop, intercept 0.62, tgt air only — on exactly two hulls and no others (measured: sam_hhq9's only users are destroyer_c and cruiser_c). Alongside it, vls:64 on the 052D and vls:112 on the 055, radarQ 32 and 41, sonar 8.8 and 9.2.
findings.whatIsReal: Correct, and it is the single most important distinction the brief asks about. The game does separate an HHQ-9 fleet-defence ship from a point-defence escort in e20, the cell counts are exactly right (Type 052D 64, Type 055 112), and the gun, CIWS and ASW torpedo all carry indigenous Chinese designations (H/PJ-38, H/PJ-11, Yu-7) rather than borrowed foreign ones. threat.js also rates cruiser_c at tier 3 alongside the B-2 and the F-22, which is the right judgement about a Type 055.
findings.fix: Nothing. Checked and sound.

findings.unit: every PLA naval hull carrying navgun_76
findings.whatTheGameHas: The source line says navgun_76, "OTO 76mm Super Rapid" — an Italian gun. But generations.js's NAVGUN pass (js/generations.js:778) substitutes per faction and rewrites it for the PLA to "H/PJ-26 76mm", dmg 51, acc 0.83. Measured at runtime: corvette_c's resolved weapon is navgun_76__corvette_c__corvette_c named "H/PJ-26 76mm".
findings.whatIsReal: Correct. The H/PJ-26 is the Chinese AK-176 development, not an OTO Melara, and the game already knows. The pass's own comment names the problem it fixed. The eras.js e00 corvette row independently names it "76mm H/PJ-26" as well. This is the exact defect class the audit was sent to find and it had already been fixed here.
findings.fix: Nothing. This is also the reason a naive source-line read of the e20 roster is wrong — resolve under jsc.

findings.unit: pla_e50_missileboat and pla_e90_carrier
findings.whatTheGameHas: Both are rows named "NONE" with full names "no missile-armed combatant in PLAN service" and "no aircraft carrier", and isPhantomUnit() (rules.js:3742) deletes them before play. Measured: neither appears in UNITS at runtime.
findings.whatIsReal: Both gaps are real. China had no anti-ship missile and no missile boat before the Type 024 Houku of 1966; the Varyag hull was bought through a Macau shell company in 1998 and sat at Dalian unreconstructed through the decade. This is realism-over-symmetry working exactly as the owner asked, with the machinery to stop the gap being sold back to the player. Worth recording as a positive because the same discipline is what is missing from the e80/e90 missile-boat slot, which has no row at all rather than a NONE row.
findings.fix: Nothing. Checked and sound.

findings.whatIsReal: Every one of these checks out against real commissioning dates, and several descriptions carry the interesting detail rather than a generic line — the four Hudong-assembled Riga kits of 1957-58, Jinan as Luda lead ship in 1971, the LM2500 turbines bought before the embargo that capped the Luhu class at two hulls, the ski-jump penalty on the J-15's launch weight, the twenty-two Type 056 hulls transferred to the Coast Guard. The anti-ship missile designation tracks the decade correctly throughout: SY-1 in 1965, YJ-83 in 2004. Nine of nineteen surface hulls audited with no finding against them.

findings.whatTheGameHas: All four are fac:"both" in rules.js, i.e. available to every faction including the PLA, and the first three plus repair_sea are in ERA_TIMELESS so they span all six eras.
findings.whatIsReal: The role x faction matrix I built initially read as "the PLAN has no minelayer, no minesweeper, no oiler and no repair ship", which would have been a finding. edits.why: FATAL, and the largest single thing this audit found. FIXED_MAGAZINE is keyed on the shared weapon id but generations.js clones a weapon per unit whenever a faction quality multiplier bites, so the id in def.weapons reads "ssm_oniks__cruiser_p" by the time this line runs and the lookup returns undefined. MEASURED across every hull that declares a magazine: it missed on ten of eleven — cruiser_p, destroyer_p, corvette_p, missileboat_p, corvette_k, missileboat_k, corvette_r, missileboat_r, missileboat_c and ssgn_p all had infinite deck rounds. Only missileboat_n worked, and only because NATO's DOMAIN multipliers are all 1.00 so its Harpoon was never cloned. The whole "a Slava's first salvo is terrifying and her second does not exist" mechanic was switched off for every non-NATO ship in the game.

/* FIXED_MAGAZINE is keyed on the SHARED weapon id - ssm_oniks, ssm_hf3,
       ssm_yj83 - but generations.js clones a weapon per unit whenever a
       faction quality multiplier bites, so by the time this runs the id in
       def.weapons reads "ssm_oniks__cruiser_p". The lookup missed, and
       measured across the roster it missed for ten of the eleven hulls that
       declare a magazine: every Eastern bloc, Korean, Taiwanese and Chinese
       ship had infinite deck rounds. Only missileboat_n still worked, and
       only because NATO's multipliers are all 1.00 so its Harpoon was never
       cloned. Fall back to the base id ahead of the "__" suffix. */
    const _mk = this.def.weapons[wi];
    const mag = this.def.magazine &&
                (this.def.magazine[_mk] !== undefined
                   ? this.def.magazine[_mk]
                   : this.def.magazine[String(_mk).split("__")[0]]);

THE ONE-WEAPON-PER-ERA-HULL CONSTRAINT IS SYSTEMIC, NOT PLA. 170 of 174 era naval hulls carry exactly one weapon. I fixed only the single worst instance (the 052C, where the weapon is literally NAMED after the SAM launcher). Fixing the rest properly is an era-table authoring job across all eight factions, not an audit patch, and it should be decided as one policy rather than faction by faction.
